prompt:
Pixel-art sprite sheet for a horizontal arcade shoot-'em-up: the two frames of the chain shot: a purple zigzag plasma link and its forked hook.

Design identity to keep exactly — violet-purple plasma (#a058e8 body, #e0c0ff hot edges, dark #4a1a8a core line) with hard pixel facets; the link reads as three or four short bar segments in a lightning zigzag, the hook as the same bar bent into an arc ending in a two-pronged fork.

Rebuild it as a sprite sheet under this strict contract:
- On a CONTINUOUS flat pure bright green chroma-key background, exactly hex #51e018, identical solid colour in every background pixel: no gradient, no vignette, no shadow, no floor plane, no panel, no second green shade.
- EXACTLY 2 square cells laid out as 1 ROWS OF 2 (2-column by 1-row) — every cell holding exactly ONE subject; a missing, empty or merged cell ruins the entire sheet.
- Cells in reading order (left-right, then top-bottom):
  cell 1 = the chain link bolt — a horizontal zigzag bolt of linked plasma segments, pointing right, its short segments joined at sharp angles The subject lies within aspect 2.3:1 to 5.2:1, the same style, palette and cell-centred placement as the other cells — only the named subject changes.
  cell 2 = the chain fork hook — a bent plasma arc that forks into two short prongs at its tip The subject lies within aspect 0.9:1 to 2.2:1, the same style, palette and cell-centred placement as the other cells — only the named subject changes.
- The sheet canvas measures EXACTLY 576×256 px. Produce EXACTLY 2 subject cells — no more, no fewer — and nothing else on the sheet.
- Each subject sits well inside its cell with at least 12 px of unbroken flat #51e018 around it and clean flat gutters between cells: no subject may touch or cross a cell edge; keep every subject within the inner 75% of its cell.
- CENTRING AND SIZE: every subject sits at the exact centre of its cell and stays small — at least one quarter of the cell width is empty flat key to its left AND right, and the same above and below; a subject leaning on, touching or crossing a cell border ruins the whole sheet.
- NO guide lines, NO cell borders, NO divider lines, NO frames, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers anywhere on the sheet — the cell names above are ordering instructions and must NEVER be drawn.
- Style: the finest retro pixel art for its native resolution — crisp hard-edged square pixels, chunky bold forms, a rich four-to-six step shading ramp lit from the top-left with careful inner detail and real material texture, clean saturated colours, a 1-px near-black outline on every silhouette edge, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no smooth gradients.
- Cell 1's zigzag lies dead-level across the horizontal middle of its cell, LONG and LOW (about 4 times as wide as tall), with empty key above and below and nothing hanging down; cell 2's hook is centred and about one and a half times as wide as tall, prongs opening to the right.
negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, letters, labels, numbers, cell borders, guide lines, grid lines, watermark, signature, blurry, anti-aliasing, smooth gradient background, scenery, stars, cast shadow, drop shadow, multiple subjects per cell, empty cell, cropped subject, subject touching edge
